sources.name: Al Jazeera - Trump orders Pentagon, federal agencies to release files on UFOs and aliens

desc: On 20 February 2026 President Trump announced, by Truth Social post, that he would direct the Secretary of War and other relevant departments and agencies to begin identifying and releasing government files related to alien and extraterrestrial life, unidentified aerial phenomena and UFOs, along with any and all other connected information. No deadline was specified and the announcement did not clarify what would be released publicly versus reviewed. Rep. Anna Paulina Luna, chair of the House Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets, responded with public thanks in her capacity as chair; Sen. John Fetterman called it fantastic. The directive is the political context for everything Grusch has done since: the 9 June 2026 press conference was explicitly framed as pressure to convert the announcement into releases, and Grusch's line - moving from testimony to action - is the whole of it. It is also the first time the executive branch has publicly committed to the disclosure premise rather than the denial posture, which makes the pace and completeness of actual releases the central measurable of 2026.
